name: System Health Check
description: Checks connected monitoring services for active incidents, errors, warnings, performance anomalies, and resolved items.
tagline: Turns PagerDuty, Datadog, Sentry, and custom health signals into an operations status report.

ownedSettings.label: System Health Check sources
ownedSettings.description: Monitoring service credentials, optional source endpoints, and operator context.

ownedSettings.label: System health check schedule
ownedSettings.description: Cron, model, prompt, and run parameters.

settings.label: System Health Check sources
settings.description: Connect monitoring services by entering environment variable names; the secret values stay in local .env.

fields.label: PagerDuty token env var
fields.helpText: Optional. Put the actual PagerDuty REST API token in your local .env as this variable name; BFrost stores only the variable name here. Used to read active, acknowledged, and resolved incidents.

fields.label: Datadog API key env var
fields.helpText: Optional. Put your Datadog API key in .env as this variable name. Datadog requires both an API key and an application key for read API calls.

fields.label: Datadog app key env var
fields.helpText: Optional. Put your Datadog application key in .env as this variable name. Scope it to the minimum read permissions needed for monitors/events.

fields.label: Datadog API site
fields.helpText: Use your Datadog site, such as https://api.datadoghq.com or https://api.datadoghq.eu.

fields.label: Sentry token env var
fields.helpText: Optional. Put a Sentry auth token in .env as this variable name. The token needs read access for project/issues/events data.

fields.label: Sentry organization slug
fields.helpText: Your Sentry organization slug. If blank, the worker reads SENTRY_ORG from the local environment.

fields.label: Sentry projects
fields.helpText: One Sentry project slug per line. If blank, the worker reads SENTRY_PROJECT from the local environment.

fields.label: Additional health endpoints
fields.helpText: Optional. Add status pages, internal exports, JSON snapshots, or other HTTP(S) sources not covered by built-in connectors.

fields.label: Additional endpoint bearer token env vars
fields.helpText: Optional. Comma-separated .env variable names. Used only for Additional health endpoints that accept Authorization: Bearer tokens.

fields.label: Context notes
fields.placeholder: Watch production, API latency, payment flows, and worker queues. Call out anything that needs same-day action.
fields.helpText: Optional instructions, service priorities, or pasted incident summaries to include in every run.

fields.label: Publish report to Item Bus
fields.helpText: When enabled, each non-setup run publishes an ops.health-report item, including All systems nominal reports.

routes.label: Health
routes.description: Health reports across connected monitoring services.
